lessons.title: 7. GROUP BY & HAVING
lessons.description: Group orders by customer_id and select customer_id and COUNT(*) as order_count where order_count > 1 using HAVING.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: count orders per customer, keeping only customers with more than one order
SELECT customer_id, 0 AS order_count FROM orders WHERE 0 GROUP BY customer_id;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING order_count > 1;

tests.name: test_group_by_customer
tests.description: Result set must match the expected rows exactly.

source.name: SQLite official documentation (sqlite.org) — SELECT — GROUP BY and HAVING clauses

learning_objectives: Collapse rows into groups with GROUP BY
Filter groups after aggregation with HAVING
